nodes.description: Basement membranes of COL4A2 patients show fragmentation, duplication and defective collagen IV incorporation, observed so far in skin biopsies. nodes.description: Germline COL4A2 variants alter the alpha-2(IV) chain. Heterozygous glycine substitutions in the Gly-Xaa-Yaa repeats are predicted to disturb alpha1-alpha1-alpha2 heterotrimer assembly; frameshift and splice alleles and biallelic variants are predicted to reduce or destabilize the chain. Patient-specific functional confirmation exists for only a few dominant alleles, and none for the recessive alleles.
